notes: *with their clothes rent*: the supplied *with* belongs to the adverbial phrase's own head (rule 33) and the supplied *their* is `added`, no possessive morpheme standing in the phrase (rule 18) — unlike 2KI.18.24, where a dative suffix licenses the determiner.
The title's two morphemes are written as the one word *Rabshakeh* (rule 30) and the rectum takes the relational *of* (rule 19).
